ACTIVE EVERY RESPONSE. No revert after many turns. No filler drift. Still active if unsure. Off only: "stop caveman" / "normal mode".

Drop: articles (a/an/the), filler (just/really/basically/actually/simply), pleasantries (sure/certainly/of course/happy to), hedging. Fragments OK. Short synonyms (big not extensive, fix not "implement a solution for"). Technical terms exact. Code blocks unchanged. Errors quoted exact.

| Level | What change |
|-------|------------|
| **full** | Drop articles, fragments OK, short synonyms. Classic caveman |

> DROP TABLE users;

> Caveman resume. Verify backup exist first.

## claude.ai Figma
The official Figma MCP server. Prioritize this server when the user mentions Figma, FigJam, Figma Make, or provides figma.com URLs.

Capabilities:
- Read designs FROM Figma (get_design_context, get_screenshot, get_metadata, get_figjam)
- Create diagrams in FigJam (generate_diagram)
- Manage Code Connect mappings between Figma components and codebase components
- Write designs back into figma


WHEN TO USE THESE TOOLS:
- The user shares a Figma URL (figma.com/design/..., figma.com/board/..., figma.com/make/...)
- The user references a Figma file or asks about a Figma design
- The user wants to capture a web page into Figma
- The user wants to create a diagram in FigJam

URL PARSING:
Extract fileKey and nodeId from Figma URLs:
- figma.com/design/:fileKey/:fileName?node-id=:nodeId → convert "-" to ":" in nodeId
- figma.com/design/:fileKey/branch/:branchKey/:fileName → use branchKey as fileKey
- figma.com/make/:makeFileKey/:makeFileName → use makeFileKey
- figma.com/board/:fileKey/:fileName → FigJam file, use get_figjam

DESIGN-TO-CODE WORKFLOW:

Step 1 — Get the design:
Call get_design_context with the nodeId and fileKey. This is your primary tool.
It returns code, a screenshot, and contextual hints.

Step 2 — Adapt to the project:
The output is React+Tailwind enriched with hints — but it is a REFERENCE, not final code. Always adapt to the target project's stack, components, and conventions.
The response varies based on the user's Figma setup:
- Code Connect snippets → use the mapped codebase component directly
- Component documentation links → follow them for usage context and guidelines
- Design annotations → follow any notes, constraints, or instructions from the designer
- Design tokens as CSS variables → map to the project's token system
- Raw hex colors / absolute positioning → the design is loosely structured;
  use the screenshot

- update-config: Use this skill to configure the Claude Code harness via settings.json. Automated behaviors ("from now on when X", "each time X", "whenever X", "before/after X") require hooks configured in settings.json - the harness executes these, not Claude, so memory/preferences cannot fulfill them. Also use for: permissions ("allow X", "add permission", "move permission to"), env vars ("set X=Y"), hook troubleshooting, or any changes to settings.json/settings.local.json files. Examples: "allow npm commands", "add bq permission to global settings", "move permission to user settings", "set DEBUG=true", "when claude stops show X". For simple settings like theme/model, suggest the /config command.

- loop: Run a prompt or slash command on a recurring interval (e.g. /loop 5m /foo). Omit the interval to let the model self-pace. - When the user wants to set up a recurring task, poll for status, or run something repeatedly on an interval (e.g. "check the deploy every 5 minutes", "keep running /babysit-prs"). Do NOT invoke for one-off tasks.

Perfect. Now let me compile a comprehensive summary:

## InkOS Inbox/Messages Inventory

### 1. **Route/Files**

**Current Routes (2-pane existing, 3-pane inbox overhaul):**
- **`/inbox`** → `/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Boldteq App/InkOS/app/(app)/inbox/page.tsx` (22.4KB, modified in git)
  - Server component; fetches all inbox data (bookings, consent, waitlist, clients, assignments, conversations, guest residencies)
  - Passes 8 data sources as props to InboxClient
  - Route confirmed active (nav-config.ts line 115–121)

- **`/messages`** → `/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Boldteq App/InkOS/app/(app)/messages/page.tsx` (2.7KB)
  - Server component; lists conversations, auto-selects first
  - Nested route: `/messages/[conversationId]/page.tsx` (1.9KB) — thread detail view
  - Also confirmed in nav-config.ts line 141–147 as separate nav item with dynamic badge
  - Independent of inbox (different UX)

**Sidebar Nav Entry:**
- `/components/app/sidebar/nav-config.ts` lines 115–121 (Inbox), 141–147 (Messages)
- Inbox: badgeType 'count', dynamicBadge 'inbox'
- Messages: badgeType 'count', dynamicBadge 'messages'

---

### 2. **Components (Inbox)**

| File | Responsibility | Props | Features |
|------|---|---|---|
| `InboxClient.tsx` (19.9KB) | Main layout + state mgmt + urgency grouping | items[], members[], currentUserId, currentPlan, currentRole | Tab filtering (all/deposits/forms/clients/messages), search, urgency grouping (now/today/this_week/later), batch selection, keyboard shortcuts, assignment picker, snooze/archive/resolve |
| `InboxItemRow.tsx` (18.5KB) | Single item renderer | item, urgency, isSelected, isFocused, members, etc. | Icon per type, assignment dropdown, more-options menu (archive/resolve/snooze), send reminder/resend form, focus/selection toggles |
| `UrgencyGroup.tsx` (2.8KB) | Collapsible urgency section | urgency, count, children, defaultExpanded | Expand/collapse toggle, colored dot + border per urgency tier, item count badge |
| `BatchActionBar.tsx` (4.4KB) | Multi-select action toolbar | selected[], members, currentUserId, onClear, onRefresh | Resolve all, archive all, batch assign, sticky top sticky positioning |
| `AssignUserPicker.tsx` (4.9KB) | Team member dropdown | members, currentUserId, currentAssignee, onAssign | Popover with search, avatar + name + role, unassigned option, compact mobile variant |

---

### 3. **Layout**

**Current Inbox: 2-column (single-pane list)**
- PageHeader + metrics (4 cards: open queue / priority / assigned to you / held)
- PageTabs (all, deposits, forms, clients, messages)
- Search bar + state filters (active queue / all states)
- BatchActionBar (sticky, when selected.size > 0)
- UrgencyGroups (collapsible sections by urgency)
  - Each group contains InboxItemRow list
  - Rows are simple: icon, title, subtitle, action link, assignment UI
- Empty states: SearchX icon if search hit, Inbox icon if no items
- No 3-pane context panel yet

**Current Messages: 2-pane (list + detail thread)**
- ThreadList (conversations, filterable, marked read on click)
- ThreadPanel (selected conversation, message thread, composer)
- ClientContextCard (client summary: name, phone, email, recent bookings)
- Composer (reply box: channel selection, message body, send)

---

### 4. **Data Fetching**

**Inbox Page (Server Component):**
- 8 parallel Supabase queries via Promise.all() lines 38–131:
  1. Pending bookings (deposit unpaid)
  2. Consent forms unsigned (last 7d)
  3. Waitlist entries (last 24h)
  4. New clients (last 7d)
  5. inbox_assignments (state map for all items)
  6. studio_members (assignment picker data)
  7. conversations (unread, SMS/email threads)
  8. guest_residencies ending (7d window)
- No real-time subscription on inbox page
- Row-level security (RLS) via studio_id filtering

**Messages Page (Server Component):**
- `listConversations()` — queries conversations table (non-archived, limit 50)
- Auto-select first conversation on load
- On detail view: `getConversation()`, `getConversationMessages()` (limit 50), `getClientBookingsSummary()` (limit 3)
- Real-time hooks available but not yet wired to inbox:
  - `useRealtimeMessages()` — subscribes to client_communications INSERTs per conversation
  - `useRealtimeConversationList()` — subscribes to conversations UPDATEs per studio

**API Routes:**
- No dedicated `/api/inbox/` or `/api/messages/` routes (all logic in server components + actions)
- Webhook routes exist:
  - `/api/webhooks/twilio/` (SMS inbound + delivery status)
  - `/api/webhooks/dodo/` (placeholder)

---

### 5. **Channel Infrastructure**

**Channels Supported (from migrations + queries):**
- SMS (Twilio) — `/lib/sms/twilio.ts` (SendSms, webhook verification)
- Email (Resend) — `/lib/email/resend.ts` (11 templates: booking_confirmation, reminders, deposit_reminder, auto_cancel, etc.)
- WhatsApp (infrastructure ready in DB, not yet wired) — `client_communications.channel` enum includes 'whatsapp'
- Instagram/Facebook (DB schema ready, deferred to v2 per migration comment)

**Integration Points:**
- `getTwilioClient()` — lazy singleton, throws TwilioNotConfiguredError if env vars absent
- `sendSms()` — calls Twilio API, returns {sid, status}
- `sendEmail()` — Resend client, renders React templates, falls back gracefully if RESEND_API_KEY absent
- `/api/webhooks/twilio/route.ts` — receives inbound SMS + delivery status, updates client_communications, syncs conversation

**Auto-triage/Smart Replies:**
- ❌ Not yet implemented
- Urgency computation exists (`lib/inbox/urgency.ts`) but is static rule-based, not AI-driven
- No smart reply templates in code
- No context panel with client history

---

### 6. **Sidebar Nav**

**InkOS App Nav (`components/app/sidebar/nav-config.ts`, lines 103–282):**

| Section | Item | Route | Badge | Plan | Permission |
|---------|------|-------|-------|------|-----------|
| Top (unlabeled) | Dashboard | /dashboard | — | — | all |
| — | **Inbox** | **/inbox** | count (inbox) | — | all |
| — | Calendar | /calendar | count (calendar) | — | all |
| — | Projects | /projects | count (projects) | — | all |
| — | **Messages** | **/messages** | count (messages) | — | all |
| STUDIO | Clients | /clients | count (clients) | — | owner/admin/artist/receptionist |
| ... | Team | /artists | — | — | owner/admin/receptionist |
| ... | Flash Events | /flash-events | — | studio+ | artist/receptionist |
| OPERATIONS | Payments | /payments | — | — | owner/admin/artist |
| — | Inventory | /inventory | dot (inventory) | studio+ | owner/admin/receptionist |
| GROWTH | AI | /ai-design | new | pro+ | owner/admin/artist |
| LOCATIONS | Locations | /locations | — | — | owner/admin only (multi-location) |
| Bottom | Settings | /settings | — | — | all |

**Key:** Messages is its own nav item (not a subsection of Inbox). Both have dynamic badges wired to layout.tsx.

---

### 7. **SMS Templates**

**File:** `/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Boldteq App/InkOS/lib/sms/templates.ts` (modified in git)

6 template functions (all text, no HTML, GSM-7 encoding):
- `bookingConfirmation()` — ~140 chars typical
- `reminder24h()` — ~120 chars
- `reminder2h()` — ~110 chars
- `depositReceipt()` — ~100 chars
- `cancellation()` — ~120 chars
- `rescheduled()` — ~140 chars

Max 160 chars/segment. No emojis (GSM-7 compat). Date formatting includes weekday + short month + day + time.

---

### 8. **Database Schema (Messaging)**

**Tables:**
- `conversations` (new, migration 20260421100000)
  - Columns: id, studio_id, client_id, channel (sms/email/instagram/facebook/voice), external_identifier, display_name, last_message_{at,preview,direction}, assigned_to, unread_count, archived_at, starred, created_at, updated_at
  - UNIQUE: (studio_id, channel, external_identifier)
  - Indexes: studio list-view, channel filter, client detail, per-user assigned, FK support

- `client_communications` (existing, with FK to conversations)
  - Columns: conversation_id, channel, direction, subject, body, status, timestamps, provider_message_id, metadata

- `inbox_assignments` (assignment state per item)
  - Columns: studio_id, item_kind (deposit/form/waitlist/client), item_id, assigned_to, snoozed_until, archived_at, resolved_at

---

## Summary for Rebuild Plan

**Existing 2-Pane Layouts:**
1. **Inbox** (`/inbox`) — item list grouped by urgency, no context panel
2. **Messages** (`/messages`) — conversation list + thread detail + client context card

**Target 3-Pane Omnichannel Inbox:**
- Consolidate SMS + email + future WhatsApp/Instagram into single unified view
- Add real-time subscriptions (hooks ready, not connected)
- Add auto-triage ML (urgency rules exist; AI layer needed)
- Add context panel (client profile, recent bookings, conversation history)
- Add smart replies (templates needed)
- Unify nav: `/inbox` becomes primary, `/messages` redirects or merges

**Key Build Paths:**
- Reuse `InboxClient` layout + urgency grouping
- Reuse `Composer`, `ThreadPanel`, `ThreadList`, `ClientContextCard` from Messages
- Wire `useRealtimeMessages()` + `useRealtimeConversationList()` to live updates
- Extend inbox_assignments schema for conversation items
- Add AI triage service (call external LLM on conversation creation)
- Add smart reply prompt templates

-- ── Shared updated_at helper — idempotent (already exists from projects) ──────

RETURNS TRIGGER
LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $$
BEGIN
  NEW.updated_at = now();
  RETURN NEW;
END;
$$;

-- ============================================================
-- 1. conversations
-- ============================================================

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS conversations (
  id                      uuid        PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),

  -- Ownership
  studio_id               uuid        NOT NULL REFERENCES studios(id)     ON DELETE CASCADE,

  -- The client this thread belongs to; NULL until an inbound message is auto-matched
  client_id               uuid                 REFERENCES clients(id)     ON DELETE SET NULL,

  -- Channel and external address
  channel                 text        NOT NULL
                            CHECK (channel IN ('sms', 'email', 'instagram', 'facebook', 'voice')),
  external_identifier     text        NOT NULL,                            -- E.164 phone or email address

  -- Cached display: client name or raw external_identifier if unmatched
  display_name            text,

  -- Denormalized last-message fields for fast list-view rendering (maintained by trigger)
  last_message_at         timestamptz,
  last_message_preview    text,                                            -- first 200 chars of body
  last_message_direction  text
                            CHECK (last_message_direction IN ('inbound', 'outbound')),

  -- Assignment & inbox state
  assigned_to             uuid                 REFERENCES auth.users(id)  ON DELETE SET NULL,
  unread_count            int         NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  archived_at             timestamptz,
  starred                 boolean     NOT NULL DEFAULT false,

  -- Timestamps
  created_at              timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  updated_at              timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),

  -- One thread per (studio, channel, address) — prevents duplicate conversation creation
  CONSTRAINT uq_conversations_studio_channel_identifier
    UNIQUE (studio_id, channel, external_identifier)
);

-- ── Indexes on conversations ──────────────────────────────────────────────────

-- Primary list-view: non-archived first, most-recent first

  ON conversations (studio_id, archived_at NULLS FIRST, last_message_at DESC NULLS LAST);

-- Channel filter (SMS / Email / etc.)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_conversations_studio_channel
  ON conversations (studio_id, channel);

-- Client detail — "All conversations with this client"
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_conversations_client_id
  ON conversations (client_id);

-- Per-user assigned inbox
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_conversations_assigned_to
  ON conversations (assigned_to, last_message_at DESC NULLS LAST);

-- FK support for assigned_to → auth.users
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_conversations_assigned_to_fk
  ON conversations (assigned_to);

DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS trg_conversations_updated_at ON conversations;
CREATE TRIGGER trg_conversations_updated_at
  BEFORE UPDATE ON conversations
  FOR EACH ROW
  EXECUTE FUNCTION set_updated_at();

-- ── RLS on conversations ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
ALTER TABLE conversations ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;

-- SELECT: any active studio member can read their studio's conversations
CREATE POLICY "conversations_select"
  ON conversations
  FOR SELECT
  USING (
    EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM studio_members sm
      WHERE sm.studio_id      = conversations.studio_id
        AND sm.user_id        = auth.uid()
        AND sm.deactivated_at IS NULL
    )
  );

-- INSERT: owner / admin / artist / receptionist (not guest_artist — they don't send messages)
CREATE POLICY "conversations_insert"
  ON conversations
  FOR INSERT
  WITH CHECK (
    EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM studio_members sm
      WHERE sm.studio_id      = conversations.studio_id

        AND sm.deactivated_at IS NULL
        AND sm.role IN ('owner', 'admin', 'artist', 'receptionist')

-- UPDATE: owner / admin / artist / receptionist (archive, star, assign, mark-read)
CREATE POLICY "conversations_update"
  ON conversations
  FOR UPDATE
  USING (
    EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM studio_members sm
      WHERE sm.studio_id      = conversations.studio_id
        AND sm.user_id        = auth.uid()
        AND sm.deactivated_at IS NULL
        AND sm.role IN ('owner', 'admin', 'artist', 'receptionist')
    )
  );

-- DELETE: owner / admin only (archive is preferred; hard delete is owner/admin only)
CREATE POLICY "conversations_delete"
  ON conversations
  FOR DELETE
  USING (
    EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM studio_members sm
      WHERE sm.studio_id      = conversations.studio_id
        AND sm.user_id        = auth.uid()
        AND sm.deactivated_at IS NULL
        AND sm.role IN ('owner', 'admin')

-- ============================================================
-- 2. Alter client_communications — add conversation_id FK
-- ============================================================

ALTER TABLE client_communications
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS conversation_id uuid
    REFERENCES conversations(id) ON DELETE SET NULL;

-- Composite index: fetch all messages in a thread, newest first
-- Uses sent_at DESC NULLS LAST so drafts/queued messages don't float to top
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_client_comms_conversation_sent
  ON client_communications (conversation_id, sent_at DESC NULLS LAST, created_at DESC)
  WHERE conversation_id IS NOT NULL;

-- ============================================================
-- 3. Trigger: sync conversation denormalised fields on comm INSERT
-- ============================================================

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION sync_conversation_on_comm_insert()
RETURNS TRIGGER
LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $$
BEGIN
  -- Only fire when a conversation is linked
  IF NEW.conversation_id IS NULL THEN
    RETURN NEW;
  END IF;

  UPDATE conversations
  SET
    last_message_at        = COALESCE(NEW.sent_at, NEW.created_at),
    last_message_preview   = left(NEW.body, 200),
    last_message_direction = NEW.direction,
    -- Increment unread only for inbound messages (staff hasn't seen it yet)
    unread_count           = CASE
                               WHEN NEW.direction = 'inbound'
                               THEN unread_count + 1
                               ELSE unread_count
                             END,
    updated_at             = now()
  WHERE id = NEW.conversation_id;

  RETURN NEW;
END;
$$;

-- Idempotent: drop before recreate so repeated migrations are safe
DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS trg_sync_conversation_on_comm_insert ON client_communications;
CREATE TRIGGER trg_sync_conversation_on_comm_insert
  AFTER INSERT ON client_communications
  FOR EACH ROW
  EXECUTE FUNCTION sync_conversation_on_comm_insert();

-- ============================================================
-- 4. RPC: find_or_create_conversation
--    Returns the conversation id for (studio, channel, identifier),
--    creating it if it does not yet exist.
--    If it already exists and p_client_id is provided, attaches the
--    client_id when it was previously NULL (inbound auto-match upgrade).
--    SECURITY DEFINER so callers need SELECT on conversations only.
-- ============================================================

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION find_or_create_conversation(
  p_studio_id           uuid,
  p_channel             text,
  p_external_identifier text,
  p_client_id           uuid DEFAULT NULL
)
RETURNS uuid
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path = public
AS $$
DECLARE
  v_conversation_id uuid;
BEGIN
  -- Attempt to locate an existing thread
  SELECT id
  INTO   v_conversation_id
  FROM   conversations
  WHERE  studio_id           = p_studio_id
    AND  channel             = p_channel
    AND  external_identifier = p_external_identifier;

  IF v_conversation_id IS NULL THEN
    -- Create new thread
    INSERT INTO conversations (studio_id, channel, external_identifier, client_id)
    VALUES (p_studio_id, p_channel, p_external_identifier, p_client_id)
    RETURNING id INTO v_conversation_id;
  ELSIF p_client_id IS NOT NULL THEN
    -- Upgrade: attach client_id if we just identified who they are
    UPDATE conversations
    SET    client_id  = p_client_id,
           updated_at = now()
    WHERE  id         = v_conversation_id
      AND  client_id IS NULL;
  END IF;

  RETURN v_conversation_id;
END;
$$;

-- ============================================================
-- 5. Helper: mark_conversation_read
--    Sets unread_count = 0 + bumps updated_at for the given
--    conversation.  RLS-safe: callers need UPDATE on conversations,
--    which is enforced by the conversations_update policy above.
-- ============================================================

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION mark_conversation_read(p_conversation_id uuid)
RETURNS void
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path = public
AS $$
BEGIN
  UPDATE conversations
  SET    unread_count = 0,
         updated_at   = now()
  WHERE  id = p_conversation_id;

# InkOS Messages — 3-Pane Omnichannel Inbox v1

## Context

Audit PDF (`InkOS_Messages_Page_Audit.pdf`) validated three strategic calls: **omnichannel inbox (7 channels, 1 view)**, **auto-triage (Inquiry / Booking / Client tags + conditional auto-reply)**, **always-on context panel (client + bookings + deposits + consent + quick actions)**. No tattoo SaaS combines Mangomint's conversation-state depth + Inkedin's 5-channel consolidation + InkDesk's client-context sidebar + LucentDesk's auto-reply triage. InkOS owns that wedge.

Current `/messages` surface is 2-pane (ThreadList + ThreadPanel) + client context card inline. SMS (Twilio) and Email (Resend) work end-to-end. `conversations` + `client_communications` schema, RPCs (`find_or_create_conversation`, `mark_conversation_read`), Realtime hooks (`useRealtimeMessages`, `useRealtimeConversationList`), and BullMQ send-sms worker already exist.

Rebuild `/messages` into **3-pane + slide-in 4th context pane**, add triage tagging, auto-reply engine, smart reply chips (rule-based, AI-hook clean), composer power features, assignment + typing presence, internal notes, templates library, schedule send, and mass blast entry point. Ship SMS + Email fully working; Instagram / WhatsApp / Web chat / Voice = UI shell + stub webhook routes + schema-ready (flip env to activate when creds land).

Outcome: front desk clears 14 DMs in 12 min. No inquiry falls through. Every reply is informed. Artists never open Instagram for work again.

---

## Scope

### v1 — ships this build
- 3-pane layout (channel rail + conversation list + thread panel) + toggleable context pane
- 7-channel rail (SMS, Email, Instagram, WhatsApp, Web chat, Phone, All) — SMS + Email fully working; others render channel + "Connect provider" empty state when unconfigured
- Auto-triage tags: `inquiry | booking | client | rescheduling | pricing | deposit_paid | missed_call` (rule-based, deterministic)
- Auto-reply engine for new-sender inquiries (studio-editable template, tone preference)
- Smart reply chips — keyword + context-derived, render below thread
- Composer: `/`-trigger templates, internal-note toggle, schedule send, channel switcher, attach-from-library
- Context pane: client profile + upcoming bookings + deposit + consent + reference gallery + internal notes + 6 quick actions
- Assign conversation to team member (reuses existing `conversations.assigned_to`)
- Typing + viewing presence (Supabase Realtime presence — no new table)
- Internal note bubbles (yellow, staff-only, `is_internal_note=true`)
- Empty states dual pattern (zero-state w/ CTAs vs filter-zero)
- Keyboard shortcuts: `/` search · `j/k` nav · `r` reply · `a` assign · `e` archive · `!` star · `n` internal · `?` cheatsheet · `⌘+Enter` send
- Settings → Messaging page (auto-reply rules, template CRUD, tone, signature)
- Feature-gate `omnichannel_inbox` (Studio+) wired dual-layer

### v2 — explicitly out of scope (stubbed)
- Meta Graph API inbound (Instagram DM) — webhook route scaffold + handler noop
- Meta WhatsApp Cloud API inbound — webhook route scaffold + handler noop
- Web chat widget + ingest route
- Twilio Voice ingest + voicemail transcripts
- Inbound email webhook (Postmark / Resend inbound)
- AI-generated smart replies (Anthropic) — `lib/messaging/triage.ts` has single `generateSmartReplies(ctx)` adapter; rule-impl v1, AI-impl v2
- Full-text search index on `client_communications.body`
- Mass message blast composer (entry point added; existing `components/reach/BatchImportSheet` composes the blast path in later sprint)

---

## Architecture

### URL model
Switch master-detail from path-based `/messages/[conversationId]` → query-param `/messages?c=<id>&channel=<c>&filter=<f>`. Enables full 3-pane w/ shallow routing (preserves scroll state + channel + filter). Mobile still drills down via conditional render. **Delete** `app/(app)/messages/[conversationId]/` dir.

### Pane layout
CSS Grid — no resizable library (none in codebase):
```
grid-template-columns: 88px 360px 1fr 380px;
                       ^rail  ^list  ^thread ^context (collapsible)
```
`ContextPane` toggles via button in thread header; when closed, thread panel expands. Mobile: single pane w/ stack nav.

### Data flow
- Page = Server Component. Reads initial conversation list + active thread + active messages + active client bookings in parallel (already correct in `page.tsx`).
- Client state: filter/search/channel/open-conversation-id → URL searchParams (Next 16 native).
- Mutations → Server Actions (`app/(app)/messages/actions.ts`) → return `ActionResult<T>`.
- Writes to audit-critical tables (`client_communications`, `conversations`) = Supabase client `.update/.insert` OR RPC where trigger consolidates (existing `find_or_create_conversation`, `mark_conversation_read`).
- Live updates via existing `useRealtimeConversationList` (list pane) + `useRealtimeMessages` (thread pane) + new `useConversationPresence` (typing/viewing badge).

---

## Database layer — Dato

### New migration: `20260423100000_messages_v1_triage_templates.sql`
1. **`conversations` ALTER:**
   - `triage_tag text CHECK (triage_tag IN ('inquiry','booking','client','rescheduling','pricing','deposit_paid','missed_call'))` nullable
   - `resolved_at timestamptz` nullable (auto-close pattern from Mangomint)
   - `last_auto_reply_at timestamptz` nullable (debounces re-fires)
   - Index: `idx_conversations_studio_triage (studio_id, triage_tag)` for filter
2. **`client_communications` ALTER:**
   - `is_internal_note boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false`
   - `scheduled_for timestamptz` nullable (for schedule-send queued messages)
   - `reply_to_message_id uuid` nullable (threading future-use)
   - Partial index: `idx_comms_scheduled (scheduled_for) WHERE scheduled_for IS NOT NULL AND status = 'queued'` — worker polls
3. **New `message_templates`:**
   - Columns: `id, studio_id, name, slug, body, channel ('sms'|'email'|'both'), category ('aftercare'|'deposit'|'booking'|'portfolio'|'reschedule'|'inquiry_reply'|'custom'), trigger_keywords text[], is_default boolean, created_by, created_at, updated_at`
   - Unique: `(studio_id, slug)`
   - Indexes: `(studio_id, category)`, `(studio_id) WHERE is_default=true`
   - RLS: studio_members active member = SELECT; owner/admin = all INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE; artist/receptionist = INSERT/UPDATE own (`created_by = auth.uid()`)
   - Seed default templates per studio via trigger on `studios` INSERT (or via onboarding action)
4. **New `auto_reply_rules`:**
   - Columns: `id, studio_id, trigger_type ('new_inquiry'|'missed_call'|'deposit_paid'|'keyword'), keyword text?, template_id uuid REFERENCES message_templates, enabled boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT true, cooldown_minutes int DEFAULT 60, tone ('casual'|'formal') DEFAULT 'casual', created_at, updated_at`
   - Unique: `(studio_id, trigger_type, keyword)` (nulls distinct for single-trigger rules)
   - RLS: studio_members SELECT; owner/admin ALL
5. **New RPC `triage_conversation(p_conversation_id uuid) RETURNS text`:**
   - Loads conv + latest inbound message + client (if any) + upcoming bookings
   - Applies deterministic rules (spec in "Triage rules" below)
   - Updates `conversations.triage_tag`
   - Returns applied tag
   - `SECURITY DEFINER`, `SET search_path = public`
6. **New RPC `enqueue_auto_reply(p_conversation_id uuid, p_rule_id uuid) RETURNS uuid`:**
   - Reads rule → template → renders (w/ `{{studio_name}}`, `{{booking_link}}`, `{{client_first_name}}`)
   - Inserts `client_communications` row (direction=outbound, status=queued, body=rendered)
   - Sets `conversations.last_auto_reply_at = now()`
   - Worker picks up queued row and dispatches via Twilio/Resend
   - Returns new comm id
7. **Rollback block** at top of file (standard Dato pattern).
8. Regenerate types: `pnpm db:types`.

### Triage rules (pure SQL in RPC, no LLM)
```
IF sender not in clients table            → inquiry
ELIF latest inbound body ILIKE ANY kw_reschedule → rescheduling + booking
ELIF latest inbound body ILIKE ANY kw_pricing    → pricing + inquiry
ELIF client has upcoming booking (next 7d)       → booking
ELIF client has payment event metadata.kind='deposit_paid' in last 24h → deposit_paid
ELSE                                              → client
```
Keyword lists constants — `kw_reschedule = ['reschedule','move','change','switch','shift']`, `kw_pricing = ['price','how much','quote','cost','rate']`, `kw_missed_call` handled in webhook path.

# InkOS Messages — 3-Pane Omnichannel Inbox v1

## Context

Audit PDF (`InkOS_Messages_Page_Audit.pdf`) validated three strategic calls: **omnichannel inbox (7 channels, 1 view)**, **auto-triage (Inquiry / Booking / Client tags + conditional auto-reply)**, **always-on context panel (client + bookings + deposits + consent + quick actions)**. No tattoo SaaS combines Mangomint's conversation-state depth + Inkedin's 5-channel consolidation + InkDesk's client-context sidebar + LucentDesk's auto-reply triage. InkOS owns that wedge.

Current `/messages` surface is 2-pane (ThreadList + ThreadPanel) + client context card inline. SMS (Twilio) and Email (Resend) work end-to-end. `conversations` + `client_communications` schema, RPCs (`find_or_create_conversation`, `mark_conversation_read`), Realtime hooks (`useRealtimeMessages`, `useRealtimeConversationList`), and BullMQ send-sms worker already exist.

Rebuild `/messages` into **3-pane + slide-in 4th context pane**, add triage tagging, auto-reply engine, smart reply chips (rule-based, AI-hook clean), composer power features, assignment + typing presence, internal notes, templates library, schedule send, and mass blast entry point. Ship SMS + Email fully working; Instagram / WhatsApp / Web chat / Voice = UI shell + stub webhook routes + schema-ready (flip env to activate when creds land).

Outcome: front desk clears 14 DMs in 12 min. No inquiry falls through. Every reply is informed. Artists never open Instagram for work again.

---

## Scope

### v1 — ships this build

## Architecture

### URL model
Switch master-detail from path-based `/messages/[conversationId]` → query-param `/messages?c=<id>&channel=<c>&filter=<f>`. Enables full 3-pane w/ shallow routing (preserves scroll state + channel + filter). Mobile still drills down via conditional render. **Delete** `app/(app)/messages/[conversationId]/` dir.

### Pane layout
CSS Grid — no resizable library (none in codebase):
```
grid-template-columns: 88px 360px 1fr 380px;
                       ^rail  ^list  ^thread ^context (collapsible)
```
`ContextPane` toggles via button in thread header; when closed, thread panel expands. Mobile: single pane w/ stack nav.

### Data flow
- Page = Server Component. Reads initial conversation list + active thread + active messages + active client bookings in parallel (already correct in `page.tsx`).
- Client state: filter/search/channel/open-conversation-id → URL searchParams (Next 16 native).
- Mutations → Server Actions (`app/(app)/messages/actions.ts`) → return `ActionResult<T>`.
- Writes to audit-critical tables (`client_communications`, `conversations`) = Supabase client `.update/.insert` OR RPC where trigger consolidates (existing `find_or_create_conversation`, `mark_conversation_read`).
- Live updates via existing `useRealtimeConversationList` (list pane) + `useRealtimeMessages` (thread pane) + new `useConversationPresence` (typing/viewing badge).

## Database layer — Dato

### New migration: `20260423100000_messages_v1_triage_templates.sql`
1. **`conversations` ALTER:**
   - `triage_tag text CHECK (triage_tag IN ('inquiry','booking','client','rescheduling','pricing','deposit_paid','missed_call'))` nullable
   - `resolved_at timestamptz` nullable (auto-close pattern from Mangomint)
   - `last_auto_reply_at timestamptz` nullable (debounces re-fires)
   - Index: `idx_conversations_studio_triage (studio_id, triage_tag)` for filter
2. **`client_communications` ALTER:**
   - `is_internal_note boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false`
   - `scheduled_for timestamptz` nullable (for schedule-send queued messages)
   - `reply_to_message_id uuid` nullable (threading future-use)
   - Partial index: `idx_comms_scheduled (scheduled_for) WHERE scheduled_for IS NOT NULL AND status = 'queued'` — worker polls
3. **New `message_templates`:**
   - Columns: `id, studio_id, name, slug, body, channel ('sms'|'email'|'both'), category ('aftercare'|'deposit'|'booking'|'portfolio'|'reschedule'|'inquiry_reply'|'custom'), trigger_keywords text[], is_default boolean, created_by, created_at, updated_at`
   - Unique: `(studio_id, slug)`
   - Indexes: `(studio_id, category)`, `(studio_id) WHERE is_default=true`
   - RLS: studio_members active member = SELECT; owner/admin = all INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE; artist/receptionist = INSERT/UPDATE own (`created_by = auth.uid()`)
   - Seed default templates per studio via trigger on `studios` INSERT (or via onboarding action)
4. **New `auto_reply_rules`:**
   - Columns: `id, studio_id, trigger_type ('new_inquiry'|'missed_call'|'deposit_paid'|'keyword'), keyword text?, template_id uuid REFERENCES message_templates, enabled boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT true, cooldown_minutes int DEFAULT 60, tone ('casual'|'formal') DEFAULT 'casual', created_at, updated_at`
   - Unique: `(studio_id, trigger_type, keyword)` (nulls distinct for single-trigger rules)
   - RLS: studio_members SELECT; owner/admin ALL
5. **New RPC `triage_conversation(p_conversation_id uuid) RETURNS text`:**
   - Loads conv + latest inbound message + client (if any) + upcoming bookings
   - Applies deterministic rules (spec in "Triage rules" below)
   - Updates `conversations.triage_tag`
   - Returns applied tag
   - `SECURITY DEFINER`, `SET search_path = public`
6. **New RPC `enqueue_auto_reply(p_conversation_id uuid, p_rule_id uuid) RETURNS uuid`:**
   - Reads rule → template → renders (w/ `{{studio_name}}`, `{{booking_link}}`, `{{client_first_name}}`)
   - Inserts `client_communications` row (direction=outbound, status=queued, body=rendered)
   - Sets `conversations.last_auto_reply_at = now()`
   - Worker picks up queued row and dispatches via Twilio/Resend
   - Returns new comm id
7. **Rollback block** at top of file (standard Dato pattern).
8. Regenerate types: `pnpm db:types`.

### Triage rules (pure SQL in RPC, no LLM)
```
IF sender not in clients table            → inquiry
ELIF latest inbound body ILIKE ANY kw_reschedule → rescheduling + booking
ELIF latest inbound body ILIKE ANY kw_pricing    → pricing + inquiry
ELIF client has upcoming booking (next 7d)       → booking
ELIF client has payment event metadata.kind='deposit_paid' in last 24h → deposit_paid
ELSE                                              → client
```
Keyword lists constants — `kw_reschedule = ['reschedule','move','change','switch','shift']`, `kw_pricing = ['price','how much','quote','cost','rate']`, `kw_missed_call` handled in webhook path.

## Auto-triage + auto-reply engine

Wiring:
1. Inbound comm arrives (Twilio webhook OR future IG/WA).
2. Handler calls `find_or_create_conversation` (existing) → inserts `client_communications` row → trigger `sync_conversation_on_comm_insert` bumps `unread_count` + last-message fields.
3. Handler then calls `triage_conversation(conv_id)` → sets `triage_tag`.
4. Handler calls `fire_auto_reply_if_matched(conv_id, comm_id)`:
   - Loads active `auto_reply_rules` for studio.
   - Checks `last_auto_reply_at` > `now() - cooldown_minutes`.
   - Matches rule: new-client + triage=inquiry → fire.
   - Inserts outbound comm (body rendered from template).
   - BullMQ `send-sms` / `send-email` worker dispatches.
   - Updates `conversations.last_auto_reply_at`.
5. Realtime fans out to `/messages` clients instantly.

Studio-configurable variables available in templates: `{{studio_name}}`, `{{client_first_name}}`, `{{booking_link}}`, `{{portfolio_link}}`, `{{aftercare_pdf_link}}`, `{{next_available_slot}}`.

## Context

Audit PDF (`InkOS_Messages_Page_Audit.pdf`) validated three strategic calls: **omnichannel inbox (7 channels, 1 view)**, **auto-triage (Inquiry / Booking / Client tags + conditional auto-reply)**, **always-on context panel (client + bookings + deposits + consent + quick actions)**. Current `/messages` surface is 2-pane (ThreadList + ThreadPanel) + client context card inline. SMS (Twilio) and Email (Resend) work end-to-end. `conversations` + `client_communications` schema, RPCs (`find_or_create_conversation`, `mark_conversation_read`), Realtime hooks (`useRealtimeMessages`, `useRealtimeConversationList`), and BullMQ send-sms worker already exist.

## Database layer — Dato

### New migration: `20260423100000_messages_v1_triage_templates.sql`
1. **`conversations` ALTER:**
   - `triage_tag text CHECK (triage_tag IN ('inquiry','booking','client','rescheduling','pricing','deposit_paid','missed_call'))` nullable
   - `resolved_at timestamptz` nullable (auto-close pattern from Mangomint)
   - `last_auto_reply_at timestamptz` nullable (debounces re-fires)
   - Index: `idx_conversations_studio_triage (studio_id, triage_tag)` for filter
2. **`client_communications` ALTER:**
   - `is_internal_note boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false`
   - `scheduled_for timestamptz` nullable (for schedule-send queued messages)
   - `reply_to_message_id uuid` nullable (threading future-use)
   - Partial index: `idx_comms_scheduled (scheduled_for) WHERE scheduled_for IS NOT NULL AND status = 'queued'` — worker polls
3. **New `message_templates`:**
   - Columns: `id, studio_id, name, slug, body, channel ('sms'|'email'|'both'), category ('aftercare'|'deposit'|'booking'|'portfolio'|'reschedule'|'inquiry_reply'|'custom'), trigger_keywords text[], is_default boolean, created_by, created_at, updated_at`
   - Unique: `(studio_id, slug)`
   - Indexes: `(studio_id, category)`, `(studio_id) WHERE is_default=true`
   - RLS: studio_members active member = SELECT; owner/admin = all INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE; artist/receptionist = INSERT/UPDATE own (`created_by = auth.uid()`)
   - Seed default templates per studio via trigger on `studios` INSERT (or via onboarding action)
4. **New `auto_reply_rules`:**
   - Columns: `id, studio_id, trigger_type ('new_inquiry'|'missed_call'|'deposit_paid'|'keyword'), keyword text?, template_id uuid REFERENCES message_templates, enabled boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT true, cooldown_minutes int DEFAULT 60, tone ('casual'|'formal') DEFAULT 'casual', created_at, updated_at`
   - Unique: `(studio_id, trigger_type, keyword)` (nulls distinct for single-trigger rules)
   - RLS: studio_members SELECT; owner/admin ALL
5. **New RPC `triage_conversation(p_conversation_id uuid) RETURNS text`:**
   - Loads conv + latest inbound message + client (if any) + upcoming bookings
   - Applies deterministic rules (spec in "Triage rules" below)
   - Updates `conversations.triage_tag`
   - Returns applied tag
   - `SECURITY DEFINER`, `SET search_path = public`
6. **New RPC `enqueue_auto_reply(p_conversation_id uuid, p_rule_id uuid) RETURNS uuid`:**
   - Reads rule → template → renders (w/ `{{studio_name}}`, `{{booking_link}}`, `{{client_first_name}}`)
   - Inserts `client_communications` row (direction=outbound, status=queued, body=rendered)
   - Sets `conversations.last_auto_reply_at = now()`
   - Worker picks up queued row and dispatches via Twilio/Resend
   - Returns new comm id
7. **Rollback block** at top of file (standard Dato pattern).
8. Regenerate types: `pnpm db:types`.

### Triage rules (pure SQL in RPC, no LLM)
```
IF sender not in clients table            → inquiry
ELIF latest inbound body ILIKE ANY kw_reschedule → rescheduling + booking
ELIF latest inbound body ILIKE ANY kw_pricing    → pricing + inquiry
ELIF client has upcoming booking (next 7d)       → booking
ELIF client has payment event metadata.kind='deposit_paid' in last 24h → deposit_paid
ELSE                                              → client
```
Keyword lists constants — `kw_reschedule = ['reschedule','move','change','switch','shift']`, `kw_pricing = ['price','how much','quote','cost','rate']`, `kw_missed_call` handled in webhook path.

# InkOS Messages — 3-Pane Omnichannel Inbox v1

## Context

Audit PDF (`InkOS_Messages_Page_Audit.pdf`) validated three strategic calls: **omnichannel inbox (7 channels, 1 view)**, **auto-triage (Inquiry / Booking / Client tags + conditional auto-reply)**, **always-on context panel (client + bookings + deposits + consent + quick actions)**. No tattoo SaaS combines Mangomint's conversation-state depth + Inkedin's 5-channel consolidation + InkDesk's client-context sidebar + LucentDesk's auto-reply triage. InkOS owns that wedge.

Current `/messages` surface is 2-pane (ThreadList + ThreadPanel) + client context card inline. SMS (Twilio) and Email (Resend) work end-to-end. `conversations` + `client_communications` schema, RPCs (`find_or_create_conversation`, `mark_conversation_read`), Realtime hooks (`useRealtimeMessages`, `useRealtimeConversationList`), and BullMQ send-sms worker already exist.

Rebuild `/messages` into **3-pane + slide-in 4th context pane**, add triage tagging, auto-reply engine, smart reply chips (rule-based, AI-hook clean), composer power features, assignment + typing presence, internal notes, templates library, schedule send, and mass blast entry point. Ship SMS + Email fully working; Instagram / WhatsApp / Web chat / Voice = UI shell + stub webhook routes + schema-ready (flip env to activate when creds land).

```
IF sender not in clients table            → inquiry
ELIF latest inbound body ILIKE ANY kw_reschedule → rescheduling + booking
ELIF latest inbound body ILIKE ANY kw_pricing    → pricing + inquiry
ELIF client has upcoming booking (next 7d)       → booking
ELIF client has payment event metadata.kind='deposit_paid' in last 24h → deposit_paid
ELSE                                              → client
```
Keyword lists constants — `kw_reschedule = ['reschedule','move','change','switch','shift']`, `kw_pricing = ['price','how much','quote','cost','rate']`, `kw_missed_call` handled in webhook path.

2. Handler calls `find_or_create_conversation` (existing) → inserts `client_communications` row → trigger `sync_conversation_on_comm_insert` bumps `unread_count` + last-message fields.
3. Handler then calls `triage_conversation(conv_id)` → sets `triage_tag`.
4. Handler calls `fire_auto_reply_if_matched(conv_id, comm_id)`:
   - Loads active `auto_reply_rules` for studio.
   - Checks `last_auto_reply_at` > `now() - cooldown_minutes`.
   - Matches rule: new-client + triage=inquiry → fire.
   - Inserts outbound comm (body rendered from template).
   - BullMQ `send-sms` / `send-email` worker dispatches.
   - Updates `conversations.last_auto_reply_at`.
5. Realtime fans out to `/messages` clients instantly.

Studio-configurable variables available in templates: `{{studio_name}}`, `{{client_first_name}}`, `{{booking_link}}`, `{{portfolio_link}}`, `{{aftercare_pdf_link}}`, `{{next_available_slot}}`.

# InkOS Messages — 3-Pane Omnichannel Inbox v1

## Context

Audit PDF (`InkOS_Messages_Page_Audit.pdf`) validated three strategic calls: **omnichannel inbox (7 channels, 1 view)**, **auto-triage (Inquiry / Booking / Client tags + conditional auto-reply)**, **always-on context panel (client + bookings + deposits + consent + quick actions)**. No tattoo SaaS combines Mangomint's conversation-state depth + Inkedin's 5-channel consolidation + InkDesk's client-context sidebar + LucentDesk's auto-reply triage. InkOS owns that wedge.

Current `/messages` surface is 2-pane (ThreadList + ThreadPanel) + client context card inline. SMS (Twilio) and Email (Resend) work end-to-end. `conversations` + `client_communications` schema, RPCs (`find_or_create_conversation`, `mark_conversation_read`), Realtime hooks (`useRealtimeMessages`, `useRealtimeConversationList`), and BullMQ send-sms worker already exist.

Rebuild `/messages` into **3-pane + slide-in 4th context pane**, add triage tagging, auto-reply engine, smart reply chips (rule-based, AI-hook clean), composer power features, assignment + typing presence, internal notes, templates library, schedule send, and mass blast entry point. Ship SMS + Email fully working; Instagram / WhatsApp / Web chat / Voice = UI shell + stub webhook routes + schema-ready (flip env to activate when creds land).

Outcome: front desk clears 14 DMs in 12 min. No inquiry falls through. Every reply is informed. Artists never open Instagram for work again.

---

## Scope

### v1 — ships this build
- 3-pane layout (channel rail + conversation list + thread panel) + toggleable context pane
- 7-channel rail (SMS, Email, Instagram, WhatsApp, Web chat, Phone, All) — SMS + Email fully working; others render channel + "Connect provider" empty state when unconfigured
- Auto-triage tags: `inquiry | booking | client | rescheduling | pricing | deposit_paid | missed_call` (rule-based, deterministic)
- Auto-reply engine for new-sender inquiries (studio-editable template, tone preference)
- Smart reply chips — keyword + context-derived, render below thread
- Composer: `/`-trigger templates, internal-note toggle, schedule send, channel switcher, attach-from-library
- Context pane: client profile + upcoming bookings + deposit + consent + reference gallery + internal notes + 6 quick actions
- Assign conversation to team member (reuses existing `conversations.assigned_to`)
- Typing + viewing presence (Supabase Realtime presence — no new table)
- Internal note bubbles (yellow, staff-only, `is_internal_note=true`)
- Empty states dual pattern (zero-state w/ CTAs vs filter-zero)
- Keyboard shortcuts: `/` search · `j/k` nav · `r` reply · `a` assign · `e` archive · `!` star · `n` internal · `?` cheatsheet · `⌘+Enter` send
- Settings → Messaging page (auto-reply rules, template CRUD, tone, signature)
- Feature-gate `omnichannel_inbox` (Studio+) wired dual-layer

### v2 — explicitly out of scope (stubbed)
- Meta Graph API inbound (Instagram DM) — webhook route scaffold + handler noop
- Meta WhatsApp Cloud API inbound — webhook route scaffold + handler noop
- Web chat widget + ingest route
- Twilio Voice ingest + voicemail transcripts
- Inbound email webhook (Postmark / Resend inbound)
- AI-generated smart replies (Anthropic) — `lib/messaging/triage.ts` has single `generateSmartReplies(ctx)` adapter; rule-impl v1, AI-impl v2
- Full-text search index on `client_communications.body`
- Mass message blast composer (entry point added; existing `components/reach/BatchImportSheet` composes the blast path in later sprint)

## Architecture

### URL model
Switch master-detail from path-based `/messages/[conversationId]` → query-param `/messages?c=<id>&channel=<c>&filter=<f>`. Enables full 3-pane w/ shallow routing (preserves scroll state + channel + filter). Mobile still drills down via conditional render. **Delete** `app/(app)/messages/[conversationId]/` dir.

### Pane layout
CSS Grid — no resizable library (none in codebase):
```
grid-template-columns: 88px 360px 1fr 380px;
                       ^rail  ^list  ^thread ^context (collapsible)
```
`ContextPane` toggles via button in thread header; when closed, thread panel expands. Mobile: single pane w/ stack nav.

### Data flow
- Page = Server Component. Reads initial conversation list + active thread + active messages + active client bookings in parallel (already correct in `page.tsx`).
- Client state: filter/search/channel/open-conversation-id → URL searchParams (Next 16 native).
- Mutations → Server Actions (`app/(app)/messages/actions.ts`) → return `ActionResult<T>`.
- Writes to audit-critical tables (`client_communications`, `conversations`) = Supabase client `.update/.insert` OR RPC where trigger consolidates (existing `find_or_create_conversation`, `mark_conversation_read`).
- Live updates via existing `useRealtimeConversationList` (list pane) + `useRealtimeMessages` (thread pane) + new `useConversationPresence` (typing/viewing badge).

## Database layer — Dato

### New migration: `20260423100000_messages_v1_triage_templates.sql`
1. **`conversations` ALTER:**
   - `triage_tag text CHECK (triage_tag IN ('inquiry','booking','client','rescheduling','pricing','deposit_paid','missed_call'))` nullable
   - `resolved_at timestamptz` nullable (auto-close pattern from Mangomint)
   - `last_auto_reply_at timestamptz` nullable (debounces re-fires)
   - Index: `idx_conversations_studio_triage (studio_id, triage_tag)` for filter
2. **`client_communications` ALTER:**
   - `is_internal_note boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false`
   - `scheduled_for timestamptz` nullable (for schedule-send queued messages)
   - `reply_to_message_id uuid` nullable (threading future-use)
   - Partial index: `idx_comms_scheduled (scheduled_for) WHERE scheduled_for IS NOT NULL AND status = 'queued'` — worker polls
3. **New `message_templates`:**
   - Columns: `id, studio_id, name, slug, body, channel ('sms'|'email'|'both'), category ('aftercare'|'deposit'|'booking'|'portfolio'|'reschedule'|'inquiry_reply'|'custom'), trigger_keywords text[], is_default boolean, created_by, created_at, updated_at`
   - Unique: `(studio_id, slug)`
   - Indexes: `(studio_id, category)`, `(studio_id) WHERE is_default=true`
   - RLS: studio_members active member = SELECT; owner/admin = all INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE; artist/receptionist = INSERT/UPDATE own (`created_by = auth.uid()`)
   - Seed default templates per studio via trigger on `studios` INSERT (or via onboarding action)
4. **New `auto_reply_rules`:**
   - Columns: `id, studio_id, trigger_type ('new_inquiry'|'missed_call'|'deposit_paid'|'keyword'), keyword text?, template_id uuid REFERENCES message_templates, enabled boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT true, cooldown_minutes int DEFAULT 60, tone ('casual'|'formal') DEFAULT 'casual', created_at, updated_at`
   - Unique: `(studio_id, trigger_type, keyword)` (nulls distinct for single-trigger rules)
   - RLS: studio_members SELECT; owner/admin ALL
5. **New RPC `triage_conversation(p_conversation_id uuid) RETURNS text`:**
   - Loads conv + latest inbound message + client (if any) + upcoming bookings
   - Applies deterministic rules (spec in "Triage rules" below)
   - Updates `conversations.triage_tag`
   - Returns applied tag
   - `SECURITY DEFINER`, `SET search_path = public`
6. **New RPC `enqueue_auto_reply(p_conversation_id uuid, p_rule_id uuid) RETURNS uuid`:**
   - Reads rule → template → renders (w/ `{{studio_name}}`, `{{booking_link}}`, `{{client_first_name}}`)
   - Inserts `client_communications` row (direction=outbound, status=queued, body=rendered)
   - Sets `conversations.last_auto_reply_at = now()`
   - Worker picks up queued row and dispatches via Twilio/Resend
   - Returns new comm id
7. **Rollback block** at top of file (standard Dato pattern).
8. Regenerate types: `pnpm db:types`.

### Triage rules (pure SQL in RPC, no LLM)
```
IF sender not in clients table            → inquiry
ELIF latest inbound body ILIKE ANY kw_reschedule → rescheduling + booking
ELIF latest inbound body ILIKE ANY kw_pricing    → pricing + inquiry
ELIF client has upcoming booking (next 7d)       → booking
ELIF client has payment event metadata.kind='deposit_paid' in last 24h → deposit_paid
ELSE                                              → client
```
Keyword lists constants — `kw_reschedule = ['reschedule','move','change','switch','shift']`, `kw_pricing = ['price','how much','quote','cost','rate']`, `kw_missed_call` handled in webhook path.

Build migration `20260423100000_messages_v1_triage_templates.sql` for the InkOS Messages v1 rebuild. Working dir: /Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Boldteq App/InkOS

This is the DB foundation for the approved plan at `/Users/yashbaldha/.claude/plans/lets-build-whole-page-tender-petal.md`. Read that plan's "Database layer — Dato" section for full spec. Load `~/.claude/memory/projects/inkos-lessons.md` before starting.

Scope — 1 migration file, all below in single file with standard Dato rollback block at top:

## 1. ALTER `conversations`
- `triage_tag text` with CHECK constraint: IN ('inquiry','booking','client','rescheduling','pricing','deposit_paid','missed_call'). Nullable.
- `resolved_at timestamptz` nullable.
- `last_auto_reply_at timestamptz` nullable.
- Add index `idx_conversations_studio_triage` on `(studio_id, triage_tag) WHERE archived_at IS NULL AND triage_tag IS NOT NULL`.

## 2. ALTER `client_communications`
- `is_internal_note boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false`.
- `scheduled_for timestamptz` nullable.
- `reply_to_message_id uuid` nullable (no FK — soft ref, future-use).
- Partial index `idx_comms_scheduled` on `(scheduled_for) WHERE scheduled_for IS NOT NULL AND status = 'queued'`.

## 3. CREATE TABLE `message_templates`
Columns:
- `id uuid PK default gen_random_uuid()`
- `studio_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES studios(id) ON DELETE CASCADE`
- `name text NOT NULL`
- `slug text NOT NULL` — URL-safe
- `body text NOT NULL`
- `channel text NOT NULL CHECK (channel IN ('sms','email','both'))`
- `category text NOT NULL CHECK (category IN ('aftercare','deposit','booking','portfolio','reschedule','inquiry_reply','custom'))`
- `trigger_keywords text[] NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'`
- `is_default boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false`
- `created_by uuid REFERENCES auth.users(id) ON DELETE SET NULL`
- `created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()`
- `updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()`
- UNIQUE `(studio_id, slug)`
- Indexes: `(studio_id, category)`, partial `(studio_id) WHERE is_default=true`
- `updated_at` trigger via existing `set_updated_at()`
- RLS enabled, policies matching conversations pattern (studio_members join):
  - SELECT: active studio member
  - INSERT: owner/admin/artist/receptionist (enforced `studio_id` match + `created_by = auth.uid()` for non-admin)
  - UPDATE: owner/admin = any row; artist/receptionist = only own rows (`created_by = auth.uid()`)
  - DELETE: owner/admin only

## 4. CREATE TABLE `auto_reply_rules`
Columns:
- `id uuid PK default gen_random_uuid()`
- `studio_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES studios(id) ON DELETE CASCADE`
- `trigger_type text NOT NULL CHECK (trigger_type IN ('new_inquiry','missed_call','deposit_paid','keyword'))`
- `keyword text` nullable (required if trigger_type='keyword')
- `template_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES message_templates(id) ON DELETE CASCADE`
- `enabled boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT true`
- `cooldown_minutes int NOT NULL DEFAULT 60`
- `tone text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'casual' CHECK (tone IN ('casual','formal'))`
- `created_at`, `updated_at` + trigger
- Constraint: `CHECK ((trigger_type = 'keyword') = (keyword IS NOT NULL))`
- UNIQUE `(studio_id, trigger_type, keyword)` NULLS NOT DISTINCT (Postgres 15+)
- Index on `(studio_id, enabled, trigger_type)` for webhook lookup
- RLS: SELECT active member; INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE owner/admin only

## 5. CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION `triage_conversation(p_conversation_id uuid) RETURNS text`
- SECURITY DEFINER, SET search_path = public
- Logic:
  - Load conversation + client_id
  - Load latest inbound client_communications row for this conversation
  - If no client_id on conversation → 'inquiry'
  - Else check body ILIKE ANY ARRAY['%reschedule%','%move%','%change%','%switch%','%shift%'] → 'rescheduling'
  - Else check body ILIKE ANY ARRAY['%price%','%how much%','%quote%','%cost%','%rate%'] → 'pricing'
  - Else check upcoming booking within 7 days → 'booking'
  - Else check recent payment with metadata->>'kind' = 'deposit_paid' last 24h → 'deposit_paid'
  - Else → 'client'
- UPDATE conversations SET triage_tag = result WHERE id = p_conversation_id
- RETURN result

## 6. CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION `enqueue_auto_reply(p_conversation_id uuid, p_rule_id uuid) RETURNS uuid`
- SECURITY DEFINER, SET search_path = public
- Loads rule → template → conversation → client
- Checks cooldown: `last_auto_reply_at IS NULL OR last_auto_reply_at < now() - (cooldown_minutes * interval '1 minute')`
- If cooldown not elapsed → RETURN NULL
- Renders body: replace `{{studio_name}}`, `{{client_first_name}}`, `{{booking_link}}` (use COALESCE to fallback)
- INSERT into client_communications: studio_id, client_id, conversation_id, channel (from conversation), direction='outbound', status='queued', body, metadata='{"auto_reply":true,"rule_id":"..."}'::jsonb
- UPDATE conversations SET last_auto_reply_at = now() WHERE id = p_conversation_id
- RETURN new comm id

## 7. Standard InkOS patterns (non-negotiable)
- Rollback block at TOP of file
- Idempotent: all `CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS`, `ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS`, `DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS` before `CREATE`
- `set_updated_at()` trigger on every new table
- `ALTER TABLE ... ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY` on every new table
- Comments above each RLS policy explaining role scope
- No `USING` without role check
- After writing, run `pnpm db:types` to regenerate `lib/supabase/types.ts`

## 8. Feature-gate key
Also: add new key `omnichannel_inbox` to `KNOWN_FEATURE_KEYS` in `lib/billing/feature-gate.ts` with min plan 'studio'; add `messaging_ai_replies` with min plan 'pro'. (This step is DB-adjacent since it defines the gate surface.)

2. `pnpm db:types` regen
3. Updated `lib/billing/feature-gate.ts`

Do NOT hand-edit types. Run `pnpm db:types`. Verify with `pnpm typecheck` after regen. No `any`. Verify RLS on every new table before finishing.

- `triage_tag text` with CHECK constraint: IN ('inquiry','booking','client','rescheduling','pricing','deposit_paid','missed_call'). Nullable.
- `resolved_at timestamptz` nullable.
- `last_auto_reply_at timestamptz` nullable.
- Add index `idx_conversations_studio_triage` on `(studio_id, triage_tag) WHERE archived_at IS NULL AND triage_tag IS NOT NULL`.

## 2. ALTER `client_communications`
- `is_internal_note boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false`.
- `scheduled_for timestamptz` nullable.
- `reply_to_message_id uuid` nullable (no FK — soft ref, future-use).

## 3. CREATE TABLE `message_templates`
Columns:
- `id uuid PK default gen_random_uuid()`
- `studio_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES studios(id) ON DELETE CASCADE`
- `name text NOT NULL`
- `slug text NOT NULL` — URL-safe
- `body text NOT NULL`
- `channel text NOT NULL CHECK (channel IN ('sms','email','both'))`
- `category text NOT NULL CHECK (category IN ('aftercare','deposit','booking','portfolio','reschedule','inquiry_reply','custom'))`
- `trigger_keywords text[] NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'`
- `is_default boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false`
- `created_by uuid REFERENCES auth.users(id) ON DELETE SET NULL`
- `created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()`
- `updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()`
- UNIQUE `(studio_id, slug)`
- Indexes: `(studio_id, category)`, partial `(studio_id) WHERE is_default=true`
- `updated_at` trigger via existing `set_updated_at()`

  - SELECT: active studio member
  - INSERT: owner/admin/artist/receptionist (enforced `studio_id` match + `created_by = auth.uid()` for non-admin)
  - UPDATE: owner/admin = any row; artist/receptionist = only own rows (`created_by = auth.uid()`)
  - DELETE: owner/admin only

## 4. CREATE TABLE `auto_reply_rules`
Columns:
- `id uuid PK default gen_random_uuid()`
- `studio_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES studios(id) ON DELETE CASCADE`
- `trigger_type text NOT NULL CHECK (trigger_type IN ('new_inquiry','missed_call','deposit_paid','keyword'))`
- `keyword text` nullable (required if trigger_type='keyword')
- `template_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES message_templates(id) ON DELETE CASCADE`
- `enabled boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT true`
- `cooldown_minutes int NOT NULL DEFAULT 60`
- `tone text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'casual' CHECK (tone IN ('casual','formal'))`
- `created_at`, `updated_at` + trigger
- Constraint: `CHECK ((trigger_type = 'keyword') = (keyword IS NOT NULL))`
- UNIQUE `(studio_id, trigger_type, keyword)` NULLS NOT DISTINCT (Postgres 15+)
- Index on `(studio_id, enabled, trigger_type)` for webhook lookup
- RLS: SELECT active member; INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE owner/admin only

## 5. CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION `triage_conversation(p_conversation_id uuid) RETURNS text`
- SECURITY DEFINER, SET search_path = public
- Logic:
  - Load conversation + client_id
  - Load latest inbound client_communications row for this conversation
  - If no client_id on conversation → 'inquiry'
  - Else check body ILIKE ANY ARRAY['%reschedule%','%move%','%change%','%switch%','%shift%'] → 'rescheduling'
  - Else check body ILIKE ANY ARRAY['%price%','%how much%','%quote%','%cost%','%rate%'] → 'pricing'
  - Else check upcoming booking within 7 days → 'booking'
  - Else check payments table for recent payment with metadata->>'kind' = 'deposit_paid' last 24h → 'deposit_paid' (if payments table exists; skip clause if not)
  - Else → 'client'
- UPDATE conversations SET triage_tag = result WHERE id = p_conversation_id
- RETURN result

## 6. CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION `enqueue_auto_reply(p_conversation_id uuid, p_rule_id uuid) RETURNS uuid`
- SECURITY DEFINER, SET search_path = public
- Loads rule → template → conversation → client
- Checks cooldown: `last_auto_reply_at IS NULL OR last_auto_reply_at < now() - (cooldown_minutes * interval '1 minute')`
- If cooldown not elapsed → RETURN NULL
- Renders body: replace `{{studio_name}}`, `{{client_first_name}}`, `{{booking_link}}` tokens via REPLACE chain (fallback to empty string if not available)
- INSERT into client_communications: studio_id, client_id, conversation_id, channel (from conversation — map 'voice' to 'sms' for outbound reply), direction='outbound', status='queued', body, metadata='{"auto_reply":true,"rule_id":"..."}'::jsonb
- UPDATE conversations SET last_auto_reply_at = now() WHERE id = p_conversation_id
- RETURN new comm id

- Rollback block at TOP of file (DROP in reverse order)
- Idempotent: `CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS`, `ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS`, `CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS`, `DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS` before `CREATE TRIGGER`
- `set_updated_at()` trigger on every new table (function already exists — just `CREATE TRIGGER`)
- `ALTER TABLE ... ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY` on every new table
- Comments above each RLS policy explaining role scope
- No `any` ever; no raw sql strings in consumer code

## 8. Feature-gate keys — add to `lib/billing/feature-gate.ts`
- Read file first, understand KNOWN_FEATURE_KEYS pattern and planMinimum map
- Add key `omnichannel_inbox` with min plan `studio`
- Add key `messaging_ai_replies` with min plan `pro`
- Do not duplicate existing keys; ensure `hasFeature()` + `requireFeatureRpc()` still compile.

- Run `pnpm db:types` after migration applied (or mock the generation if local DB not running — fall back to editing lib/supabase/types.ts only if generator fails and explicitly note the workaround).
- Run `pnpm typecheck` — fix any generated-type drift in lib/messaging/*.ts.

```bash
pnpm db:migrate         # apply migration
pnpm db:types           # regenerate types
pnpm typecheck          # must pass
```
Then sanity check in psql or Supabase Studio:
- `SELECT * FROM pg_policies WHERE tablename IN ('message_templates','auto_reply_rules');` — must return non-zero rows for each
- `SELECT proname FROM pg_proc WHERE proname IN ('triage_conversation','enqueue_auto_reply');` — must return 2 rows

- Add export type `TriageTag = 'inquiry'|'booking'|'client'|'rescheduling'|'pricing'|'deposit_paid'|'missed_call'`

  - recentBookings (last 5, finished)

- `unresolveConversation(studioId, conversationId)` — clears `resolved_at`
- `toggleInternalNote(studioId, commId, value: boolean)` — update row (verify same-studio)
- `createMessageTemplate(studioId, { name, slug, body, channel, category, trigger_keywords?, is_default? }, userId)` 
- `updateMessageTemplate(studioId, id, patch)`
- `deleteMessageTemplate(studioId, id)`

import type { TriageTag, ConversationWithClient, ConversationMessage, ClientBookingSummary, ClientSummary } from './queries'

export interface SmartReplyContext {
  conversation: ConversationWithClient
  lastInboundMessage: ConversationMessage | null
  upcomingBookings: ClientBookingSummary[]
}

export type SmartReplyAction =
  | { kind: 'send_template'; templateSlug: string }
  | { kind: 'open_calendar_reschedule'; bookingId: string }
  | { kind: 'share_portfolio' }
  | { kind: 'offer_slots'; days: 1 | 3 | 7 }
  | { kind: 'send_aftercare_pdf' }
  | { kind: 'request_deposit' }

export interface SmartReply {
  id: string
  label: string
  action: SmartReplyAction
}

// v1 rule-based implementation; AI-ready signature
export async function triageConversation(studioId: string, conversationId: string): Promise<TriageTag> {
  // Call RPC triage_conversation via authenticated supabase client; return result
}

export async function generateSmartReplies(ctx: SmartReplyContext): Promise<SmartReply[]> {

# Code Review: InkOS Messages v1 Rebuild

**Date:** 2026-04-23 · **Reviewer:** Sage · **Mode:** A (Full audit of sprint diff) · **Stack:** A

## Automated Scans
| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| `pnpm typecheck` | PASS (0 errors) |
| `pnpm build` | PASS |
| `pnpm lint` | 2 errors / 2 warnings — all in unrelated pre-existing files (calendar tests, vitest.config). Zero lint issues in sprint diff. |
| `grep : any / as any / @ts-ignore` (sprint scope) | Clean |
| Console.log scan (sprint scope) | Clean |
| Hex literals (sprint scope) | Clean |
| Banned color classes (sprint scope) | Clean |
| Default Tailwind shadows (sprint scope) | Clean |
| Timing-safe HMAC on new webhooks | PASS (IG, WA, webchat) |
| Rate limit on new webhooks | PASS (IG, WA, webchat) |

## Findings

| # | Sev | Cat | File:Line | Issue | Fix |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | **CRITICAL** | Feature gate | `app/(app)/messages/page.tsx:42-48` + `app/(app)/messages/actions.ts` (entire file) | **Dual-layer gate broken on the primary surface.** Settings page gates `omnichannel_inbox`, but the Messages page itself and all 20+ server actions (`sendMessageAction`, `scheduleSendAction`, `createTemplateAction`, etc.) never call `requireFeatureRpc`. A Solo-tier user who knows the route or POSTs to an action bypasses billing entirely. | Add `await requireFeatureRpc(supabase, studioId, 'omnichannel_inbox')` in `MessagesPage` (catch `FeatureGateError` → `UpgradeGatePageBlock`) and in every mutation action after `getAuthenticatedUser()`. |
| 2 | **CRITICAL** | RLS / service-role abuse | `lib/messaging/send.ts:49,75,103,142,213,283` | `sendSmsToClient`, `sendEmailToClient`, `sendInternalNote`, `resolveClientPhone/Email`, `upsertConversation` all use `createServiceRoleClient()`. These are invoked from server actions (`/messages/actions.ts`). The actions trust the `studioId` from `authUser.studioId`, but every `clientId` / `conversationId` comes from client input (Zod validated as UUID only). Service-role bypasses RLS, so a crafted call with a valid UUID from another studio's client succeeds in `resolveClientPhone` / the insert because the only guard is the `.eq('studio_id', studioId)` filter — which DOES protect reads, but `sendInternalNote` (line 283-305) inserts using user-provided `conversationId` + `clientId` with no cross-studio verification that they belong to `studioId`. | Either (a) switch `lib/messaging/send.ts` to `await createClient()` and rely on RLS, OR (b) add an explicit verification query (`SELECT 1 FROM conversations WHERE id=$1 AND studio_id=$2`) before every insert that accepts client-supplied IDs. Option (a) is preferred — the service-role bypass isn't justified here (session exists). |
| 3 | **SEVERE** | TS discipline | `lib/messaging/triage.ts:56-61,282-287` | `(supabase.rpc as unknown as (name, args) => Promise<...>)` — double-cast to bypass the generated types because `triage_conversation` + `enqueue_auto_reply` weren't regenerated into `lib/supabase/types.ts`. Comment admits "types were surgically patched." This is the stale-types trap the project's own CLAUDE.md (§8, §9) explicitly forbids. | Run `pnpm db:types` against the live schema so the Functions union includes the two new RPCs; delete both double-casts. If remote isn't reachable, hand-add only the Functions signatures in the generated file with a `// GENERATED` marker — not blanket `as unknown as`. |
| 4 | **SEVERE** | Security / data loss | `app/api/webhooks/twilio/route.ts` (no ratelimit) vs IG/WA/webchat (rate-limited) | New sibling webhooks (IG, WA, webchat) have `apiRatelimit`; the existing Twilio route still has none. Not strictly "new this sprint" but this sprint added two more callouts into it (`triageConversation`, `fireAutoReplyIfMatched`) which now do extra DB work per request — amplifying the DoS surface. | Add `apiRatelimit.limit(ip)` at top of Twilio `POST`. Keep 200 on rate-limit to avoid Twilio retries stampede, or 429 — pick one and comment. |
| 5 | **SEVERE** | Webhook config-fail semantics | `app/api/webhooks/instagram/route.ts:60`, `whatsapp/route.ts:68`, `webchat/route.ts:37` | When secret env var is missing, handlers log `error` then return **200** "Webhook not configured". Returning 200 silently ACKs the provider — Meta will mark the delivery successful and never retry. Should be 503 for IG/WA (Meta retries), or at least a distinct 500 so ops sees it. Twilio route does the same anti-pattern. | Return `503` (or `500`) when secret is missing. 200-on-soft-error only applies to post-verified payload errors, not config failures. |
| 6 | **SEVERE** | RLS / auth | `lib/messaging/templates-seed.ts:128` + `app/(app)/messages/actions.ts:650 (seedDefaultTemplatesAction)` | `seedDefaultTemplatesAction` calls `seedDefaultTemplates()` which uses `createServiceRoleClient()`. The action is exposed to any authenticated user and seeds templates for `authUser.studioId`.
